title: Grogu
description: Grogu was a Force-sensitive child who was found by Din Djarin, The Mandalorian. Djarin would liberate Grogu from Imperial captivity and undergo a quest to return him to his people: the Jedi. Moff Gideon captured him, but Djarin and his allies saved the child. Grogu underwent Force training with Luke Skywalker,  but chose to return to the side of Djarin.
